design.title: Baseline seed: current model/ code, no design agent
design.eli5: This row is the starting line, not an idea being tested. The model that happens to be in the repo right now is trained and measured so there is a real number on the board; everything after this is an attempt to beat it.
design.hypothesis: Not a hypothesis -- a starting line. Run with SKIP_AGENT=1 so no design or implementation agent is involved: whatever is in model/ is trained and scored as-is to establish the number later experiments must beat, and to prove the harness works end to end.
